about: TikZ diagrams drawn as pictures in the PowerPoint deck. Keys are page numbers of the default Beamer PDF; rect is [x0, y0, x1, y1] in mm from the top-left corner of the 160 x 90 mm page. Everything whose centre lies inside a rect becomes part of the picture, so a rect must not reach into editable text next to the diagram. Included PDF graphs are found automatically and need no entry. Build steps come from the overlay pages and need no entry either.
